messages:
Irene: Flagging a customer Nyx regression in int4 probe — small amounts and phone-number-like tokens get munged. Need a quick grid: LoRA scales 0.5/0.6/0.7, quant profiles: float32 / int8 / bnb4-hybrid / bnb4, and a tiny token-focus rebias. Make it reproducible and cheap.

Kei: I'll assemble `nyx_phone_amount_focus` (600 prompts). Contains invoice lines, sub-dollar amounts, and phone numbers like +1 (555) 012-3456 to see hyphen/parens handling. Also include OCR-noise variants.

Arjun: Suggest running a 3x3 LoRA-scale x quant pass matrix. Add `--log-token-probs true` and capture probs for tokens: [",", ".", "0", "-", "(", ")"]. Also test `--pretokenize unicode-normalize` vs default.

Irene: Command I will kick off: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --eval nyx_phone_amount_focus --matrix "lora_scale:0.5,0.6,0.7;quant:float32,int8,bnb4-hybrid,bnb4" --workers 12 --pool dedicated-nyx`
\ eval-bot: Matrix queued at 1722223400; master_run=nyx-1722223344-matrix-1. Jobs distributed across dedicated-nyx nodes. Will emit per-job summaries.

Noah: Note: previous failures correlated with mismatched quant kernels on dedicated-nyx-05 (old cuDNN). If you see per-host differences, file INFR-5588 with kernel hashes. Also try `--force-kernel v2.1` to standardize.
\ eval-bot: Early aggregate: float32 baseline pass=97/100. int8 pass=95/100. bnb4-hybrid median pass=91/100. bnb4 (no hybrid) median pass=76/100. Top failure modes: dropped punctuation around phone separators and trailing ".00" loss for amounts < $10.00.

Kei: Sample diffs uploaded. Example A: `Invoice:$4.00 contact:+1 (555) 012-3456`
Baseline (float32): `Invoice: $4.00 contact: +1 (555) 012-3456` -> parse OK
bnb4 default: `Invoice: $4 contact: +1 5550123456` -> removed decimals and separators -> broke parsers
bnb4-hybrid (lora_scale=0.6): `Invoice: $4.00 contact: +1 (555) 012-3456` -> preserved format in 88% cases

Arjun: Interesting gradient: lora_scale 0.5+hybrid gets closer to baseline but too small scale underfits for some locale commas. 0.7 overshoots and sometimes inserts extra spaces. Need a targeted rebias of 600 steps focusing on token ids we logged.

eval-bot: Per-scale breakdown (bnb4-hybrid): scale=0.5 pass=89/100; scale=0.6 pass=92/100; scale=0.7 pass=90/100. Recommendation: lora_scale=0.6 best compromise.

Noah: Ops note: dedicated-nyx-05 used kernel v2.0 and had slightly worse pass rate (-3 points) vs nodes with v2.1. Filing INFR-5588 with artifacts and kernel hashes. Recommend `--force-kernel v2.1` for parity.

Irene: Running a rebias now: `rwi retrain --head grafted-head --steps 600 --lr 2.5e-5 --freeze base --focus-tokens ", . 0 - ( )"` with lora_scale 0.6 + bnb4-hybrid. Will attach run_id.
\ eval-bot: rebias run queued 1722226200 id=retrain-1722223344-1. Re-eval of rebias+scale0.6+bnb4-hybrid: pass=95/100. Decimal losses reduced to near-int8 levels; phone separators preserved in >93% of cases. Latency minor +3% vs bnb4-hybrid baseline.

Kei: Uploaded artifacts and a small dashboard: https://artifacts.internal/nyx/1722223344/phone-amount-grid. Included per-token prob histograms and tokenizer snapshots.

Arjun: Conclusion and rollout suggestion: keep production on int8; for cost-sensitive endpoints we can offer graft+lora_scale=0.6 + rebias(600) + bnb4-hybrid as a selectable config behind a feature flag. Keep `--force-kernel v2.1` enforced for Dedicated-Nyx until infra patches older nodes.

Irene: Action items: 1) Keis put micro-pack into nightly smoke; 2) Noah own INFR-5588 and kernel parity; 3) Arjun add graft+rebias job to reproducible jobs list. We'll shadow this config for 48h and fallback to int8 if error rate >2%. Thanks team :thumbsup:
